latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video for Product Marketing — Initial Release

- Create product promo videos from user-uploaded images or footage (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 500MB).
- Fast cloud-based processing with GPU acceleration, delivering 1080p MP4 videos within 1–2 minutes.
- Simple onboarding: automatic session and token handling for both registered and unregistered users.
- Supports custom text overlays, background music, and aspect ratios optimized for ads and social media.
- Exposes common workflows: upload, edit, preview timeline, export, and check credit/status.
- Clear guidance on supported formats, error handling, and export requirements.
